Comment: Stage 2: generate the method to recreate an identified dish. Only runs when the user presses 'Reverse engineer' - this is the heaviest-output and most expensive part of the pipeline. Ported from orchestrators/recipe_orchestrator.py.

QueryCulinaryEmbeddings.Comment: Retrieval step that grounds the generator. The handler derives the query text from the matched dish name, falling back to the vision guess - ASL has no way to express that fallback, so it belongs in the Lambda.

GenerateRecreation.Comment: The most expensive call in the app. Retried at most twice and with a long timeout, because a partial retry storm here is the fastest way to burn the model budget.

MarkRecipeFailed.Comment: Reverts the job to Identified rather than Failed. Stage 1 succeeded, so the restaurant match and dish identification are still good - a transient generator error must not throw those away, and the user keeps a working 'Reverse engineer' button.

RecipeFailed.Cause: Stage 2 failed; the job has been reverted to Identified and can be retried.
